title: Quality
text: Quality. I put a brand new battery in this clock when I got it but it seems to keep jumping ahead on the time. Every. Single. Day. I don’t like how flimsy the clock hands are either. I’m not impressed with this product.

product_metadata.title: FirsTime & Co. Rustic Barn Wall Clock, 18", Natural Wood
features: SIZE MATTERS - This battery-operated clock has a 18" height, 2" depth and 18" length making it the perfect wall clock for any living room, office, kitchen, bedroom, bathroom or entryway

IT'S IN THE DETAILS - Our round Rustic Barn Wood Wall Clock has a stained brown finish and is made of solid wood with metal hands. Each wood product is unique with variations in grain, color and finish from natural and handcrafted characteristics

FASHIONABLE AND FUNCTIONAL - This beautiful analog clock features an open face with a weathered wooden plank design. Complete with a unique mix of numbers and Roman numerals, this clock will make a statement in any home or office space

HANG IN THERE – This clock is designed to be hung on the wall and has 1 keyhole hanger on the back for easy installation. Hanging hardware is not included. It requires 1 AA battery for operation, not included
RUSTIC STYLE - Whether moving into a new home or looking for a gift, make an accent statement in any room with a stylish and decorative rustic and farmhouse piece from FirsTime & Co.
description: Nothing ties a room together better than a great clock, and the one you choose to place in your home should reflect your personality and style. We hear you. Bring a farmhouse look home today with our FirsTime & Co. Brown Rustic Barn Wood Wall Clock. Crafted of weathered solid wood panels with a stained brown finish, this timepiece features an 18" diameter that is sure to be the centerpiece of any living space. Complete with a unique mix of large easy-to-read numbers and Roman numerals, this clock will make a statement in any living room, office, kitchen, bedroom, bathroom or entryway. Finding the right clock to suit your style has never been easier thanks to our wide range of FirsTime & Co. timekeeping solutions.
